subject: Request: temporary evening settlement throughput carveout
messages:
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@clearsettle.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: payments-team@clearsettle.com
Date: 2025-08-20T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evening settlement window - temporary throughput need

Hi Kimberly / Priyom,

We're ramping up a new end-of-day ACH settlement flow that will peak during our evening batch window (8pm-10pm PT) for the next three business days (26th-28th Aug). Traffic will be bursty: we estimate ~9k requests over a 2-hour window (approx 1.25rps average, spikes to ~12rps for short bursts).

Our current integration is hitting Redwood's fairness throttles and we're seeing elevated tail latency (4–6s) which is causing downstream retries and settlement delays. We need a temporary carveout or elevated throughput allowance for those evenings to avoid failed settlements.

Can Redwood provide a short-term SLA exception (throughput uplift + temporary higher per-minute ratecap) and confirm fallback behavior if capacity is constrained? We also need a simple artifact we can share with our ops team showing the exact hours and limits.

Appreciate quick turnaround — this affects live money movement.

Thanks,
Eleanor Park
Head of Payments Ops
ClearSettle

Attachments: settlement-traffic-sample.csv (CSV), peak-window-summary.txt
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@clearsettle.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-20T19:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evening settlement window - temporary throughput need

Eleanor — thanks for the details and the heads-up. We're treating this as an urgent carveout request. Two quick asks so we size this correctly:

- Can you confirm whether the 9k requests are single-token generation calls or multi-prompt (avg token counts)?
- Do you want a strict throughput uplift (rps) or a tokens/minute uplift? Either works but we need to map to our rate-limiter config.

I'll loop in Rishi to validate capacity and Priyom to propose the SLA language and a short-term amendment.

—Kimberly Park
Senior Enterprise Account Manager
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Eleanor Park <eleanor@clearsettle.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evening settlement window - temporary throughput need

On Wed, Aug 20, 2025 at 7:03 PM kimberly_park@redwood.ai wrote:
> Eleanor — thanks for the details and the heads-up. We're treating this as an urgent carveout request. Two quick asks so we size this correctly:
>
> - Can you confirm whether the 9k requests are single-token generation calls or multi-prompt (avg token counts)?
> - Do you want a strict throughput uplift (rps) or a tokens/minute uplift? Either works but we need to map to our rate-limiter config.

Hi everyone — looked at the sample traffic and logs Eleanor attached. Quick summary from infra: average request body size ~ 420 tokens (prompt+context), median latency currently 380ms under normal load, spiking on tail at the hours Eleanor mentioned.

Engineering recommends: temporary per-minute token uplift of 600k tokens/min for the 8pm-10pm PT window, enforced as a time-bounded policy for 3 days. That maps to ~10rps sustained at your average token size with headroom for spikes.

Fallback behavior: if aggregate platform capacity is constrained we will fail open to a lower-fidelity model (compatible variant) at a configurable routing priority, and throttle by fairness rules if necessary. We can lock a per-customer prioritized queue for the 2-hour window to reduce impact, but that requires a short notice change to your routing policy.

Estimated incremental cost for the three evenings: $1,200 (per our committed pricing tiers).

I'll attach a snippet of the rate-limit policy we propose.

—Rishi
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-rate-policy-snippet.json (text)
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@clearsettle.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-08-21T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evening settlement window - temporary throughput need

Eleanor — drafting a short-term SLA amendment and carveout template and attaching it. Key points in the proposed language:

- Timebox: 2025-08-26 20:00 PT through 2025-08-28 22:00 PT (daily 2-hour window)
- Uplift: 600k tokens/min (time-limited) mapped to a customer-level policy ID
- Latency SLO: best-effort 95th percentile <= 1.5s for the uplift window; this is softer than our standard SLO given the temporary nature
- Fallback: automatic routing to a compatible, lower-cost model if platform-wide capacity is constrained; Redwood will notify ClearSettle and kick a retry-backoff flag
- Cost: one-time uplift fee $1,200 for the 3-day window
- Signing: DocuSign link to accept amendment

If this looks good I'll send to Eleanor as an official amendment.

Attachment: requested_carveout_template.docx

—Priyom
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@clearsettle.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: payments-team@clearsettle.com
Date: 2025-08-23T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evening settlement window - temporary throughput need

Thanks — the proposed amendment looks fine to us. We prefer the tokens/minute uplift and accept the softer latency SLO for the uplift window.

Please proceed and send the DocuSign; we'll have the payments ops team and legal sign promptly. Also can you attach the simple one-page ops artifact describing hours/limits so we can paste into our runbook?

Eleanor
Head of Payments Ops
ClearSettle
